name: ...Walk It Dry
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Stomp a Mudhole... is in your Ring area. Discard 1 card, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: 3 Minutes and We're Out
Text: Your opponent reveals his Backlash deck and randomly discards 3 Pre-match cards. When your opponent cannot play any Title Belt except the Tag Team Title Belts, reveal your Backlash deck and randomly discard 3 Pre-match cards. Put any discarded cards with the Raw logo into your Backlash deck.

name: According to Linda and the Board of Executives
Text: Cannot be played by Right to Censor. The maximum number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area are both increased by 2. Ignore the 'Can only be played...'text on your cards titled Not According to the Fine Print! Your opponent searches your Arsenal and Backlash deck. If he finds a Face or Heel card, you lose the game via Pinfall Victory. Shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Add Insult to Injury
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Your opponent may overturn 5 cards. If he does not, he discards 2 cards.

name: All I Care About Are My Freaks and My Peaks
Text: As an action, put up to 2 Maneuver cards from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Always
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your opponent's Ring area to reverse any card or effect your opponent controls that removes any number of your cards from your Ring area and end your opponent's turn.

name: Backstage Donnybrook
Text: After your and your opponent's Pre-match phases, before the first turn of the game, all players set their hands aside, draw cards equal to the number of cards set aside, and then shuffle the cards set aside into their Arsenals. Rikishi, Brothers of Destruction, and Ric Flair draw 2 fewer cards.

name: Backstage Politics
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. When this card is in your Ring area, during your opponent's turn, he may put 1 non-unique card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile and put this card into his Ring area. When this card is in any Ring area, cards that go to Right to Censor's Ringside pile are removed from the game and their cards and effects cannot modify the Fortitude of their opponent's Reversal cards.

name: Beat You Raw
Text: If your opponent does not have a card in his Ring area with the Smackdown logo, this card is -6F and you may remove it from the game and draw 1 card. If your opponent has a card in his Ring area with the Smackdown logo, your cards cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck for the rest of the turn.

name: Big Evil - Red Devil
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile to search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Reversal card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your Ringside pile, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Big Freak'n Powerslam
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Big Poppa Pump
Text: During your turn, you may discard any number of cards and your next Maneuver card played this turn is -4F for each card discarded. You cannot play more than 2 maneuvers per turn.

name: Blind Tag
Text: Can only be played if you are an inactive member of your team. Cannot be reversed if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. As an action, you are now the active player and may begin your turn. As a reversal, reverse any Set-up card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Body Vise
Text: If reversed from your opponent's hand or Backlash deck, he may remove 1 card in your Ringside pile from the game. When successfully played, you may remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: Capture Suplex
Text: As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled From the Top Rope and end your opponent's turn.

name: Chase Off Manager
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by a Male Superstar. You may put 1 Pre-match Manager from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play the card titled Manager Interferes.

name: Chavo's Inverted Powerbomb
Text: You may search for this card as if it were a High Risk maneuver. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the cards titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope and end your opponent's turn. If the first card you play on your next turn is a High Risk maneuver, you can ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: Cheat 2 Win
Text: Search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for 2 Face or 2 Heel cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Chief Morley Says...
Text: Can only be played if you have fewer Reversal cards in your Ring area than your opponent. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent reverses a card from his hand or Backlash deck, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and put the reversed card into your hand. When this card is in your Ringside pile, before your Draw Segment, you may discard 1 card and put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: Collegiate Champions
Logos: Team Angle, Kurt Angle, Brock Lesnar
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 3 cards, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent discards the chosen card. When this card is put into your Ringside pile from your Ring area, you may look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent discards the chosen card.

name: Cripple Opponent
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, you may choose 1 Maneuver card and 1 Action card, and your opponent discards the chosen cards.

name: Crowd Pleaser
Text: This card is +#F, where # is equal to the number of cards with the word 'shoot'in the title in all Ring areas. Draw up to # cards and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards with the word 'shoot'in the title in all Ring areas.

name: Cut the Ring in Half
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Your opponent cannot 'tag'out for the rest of this turn and during his next turn.

name: Dance, Coach, Dance!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your non-unique cards with the Raw logo are -#F, where # is equal to the number of cards with the Raw logo in your Ring area.

name: Do Something!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, if your opponent has 8 or more cards in his hand, he discards 2 cards.

name: Don't Cross a McMahon
Text: Can only be played if you have the card titled Backstage Politics or a card with the word 'McMahon'in the title in your Ring area. Reverse any Action card of printed 5F or greater and end your opponent's turn. If the card titled Managed by Vince McMahon is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1.

name: Don't Hunt What You Can't Kill
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Don't Trust Nobody
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Don't Try This at Home
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for the card titled From the Top Rope, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any Activated Card Effect, put that card into your opponent's Ringside pile, he discards 2 cards, and ends his turn.

name: Double Face Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and can only be played as the first card of your turn. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Dude ... Whatever
Text: Cannot be reversed. When this card is in your Ring area or Ringside pile, before your Draw Segment, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any 8D or greater maneuver or completely reverse any Multi card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Dude, Try Something Else
Text: If your opponent is Dude Love, this card is -6F. When played from your hand, reverse any non-unique card and your opponent continues his turn. If your opponent is Dude Love, the card reversed is removed from the game. When played from your hand by Rob Van Dam, reverse any card and your opponent continues his turn.

name: Dudleyz3
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley, Spike Dudley
Text: This card is +10F when played by Spike Dudley. Can only be played if the card titled Brothers from Another Mother is in your Ring area. When played, discard your hand unless your Superstar is Buh-Buh Ray Dudley.

name: Electric Chair
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver of 8D or greater or any maneuver played after the card titled From the Top Rope and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 cards.

name: Electrifying
Text: If your next card played this turn is a Set-up card, double all numbers in its text. If your next card played this turn is a Maneuver card, ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: Extreme Warfare
Text: If the first card played during each player's turn is a Maneuver card, it can only be reversed from their opponent's Arsenal.

name: Faceplant
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Set-up card or a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, this card is -8D, reverse any non-unique card that would force you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played by Edge, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Fall into the Corner
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver of 8D or less and your opponent continues his turn. His next card played this turn is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. If your opponent is Rikishi, he may search his Arsenal for the card titled Stink Face, reveal it to you, put it into his hand, and shuffle his Arsenal.

name: Flying Choke Hold
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Submission maneuver.

name: Flying Lariat
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Strike maneuver.

name: Flying Takedown
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Grapple maneuver.

name: Forceable Entry
Text: Discard any number of cards. For every 2 cards discarded, search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, put it into his Ringside pile, and he shuffles his Arsenal.

name: Forget the Smackdown, Jabronie!
Text: If your opponent does not have a card in his Ring area with the Raw logo, this card is -6F and you may remove it from the game and your opponent discards 1 card. If your opponent has a card in his Ring area with the Raw logo, when this card is in your Ring area, you may remove it from the game to reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Freakzilla Says, 'Boom Shaka Laka!'
Text: Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage. Read as 0 in your Ring area.

name: From the Mind of Eric Bischoff
Text: Cannot be reversed if the card titled Managed by Eric Bischoff is in your Ring area. Put up to # cards with the Raw logo from your Ringside pile into your hand, where # is equal to the number of cards with the Raw logo in your Ring area. If your next card played this turn is the card titled Here's a Ratings Booster!, it cannot be reversed.

name: Genetic Freak Push-ups
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Discard up to 4 cards and then draw 2 cards for each card discarded.

name: Get Ready ... Your Candy Ass is Next!
Text: Draw up to 2 cards. Your next card played this turn can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Gimme a Hell Yeah!
Text: Draw up to # cards, where # is equal to the number of Superstar-specific cards in your Ring area. # cannot be greater than 6.

name: Give and Take
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, one member of your team discards any number of cards and another member of the team draws 1 card for every 2 discarded.

name: Give You the Runaround
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 non-unique card, and he removes the chosen card from the game. He may draw up to 3 cards.

name: Glad Someone Has My Back
Text: Can only be played if you cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts or if this is a Tag Team format match. Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You must overturn cards until you overturn 2 cards with the Tag Team logo.

name: GORE! GORE! GORE!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played 10D or greater maneuver. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Hangman's Neck Breaker
Text: When played after the card titled From the Top Rope, can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse a maneuver if that maneuver is played after the card titled From the Top Rope. When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a Grapple maneuver, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Here Comes the Pain
Text: You may put up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +3D.

name: Hey, Whatcha Doin'?
Text: Can only be played if your opponent did not attempt to play a card during his last turn. Cannot be reversed. Draw up to 2 cards and look at your opponent's hand and Backlash deck.

name: Holla If Ya Hear Me!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, look at your opponent's hand and Backlash deck, then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: How Ya Like Me Now?
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: I Ain't Not No Sucka Neitha!
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. The first card you play on your next turn cannot be reversed.

name: I Can't Be Reading This Right...
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn, if you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent, you may remove 1 card in your Ringside pile from the game and then put this card into your hand.

name: I Live for My Hulkamaniacs...
Text: This card is +#F, where # is equal to your Superstar Value. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: I Love My Testicles!
Text: Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's cards titled Dirty Low Blow are +2D.

name: I'm the King of the World
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Jerichoholics is in your Ring area. Put up to 1 Maneuver card, up to 1 Action card, and up to 1 Reversal card in your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: I'm the Underdog!
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Fans Love an Underdog is in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's Superstar Value is +#, where # is equal to the number of cards in your Ring area titled Fans Love an Underdog.

name: Inside Cradle
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, if your Fortitude Rating is at least 20F greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, or if the Stun Value in your Ring area is at least 5 greater than the Stun Value in your opponent's Ring area, you win the game via Pinfall victory.

name: Inverted Leg Lock
Text: When successfully played, remove any number of cards in your Ringside pile from the game and shuffle the same number of Maneuver cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Inverted Snake Eyes
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! When successfully played, draw up to 2 cards.

name: It's All About the Benjamins
Text: Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: It's Hard Being This Original
Text: Cannot be played by Rikishi, Right to Censor, Brothers of Destruction, or Dude Love. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 2 different non-unique cards, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. You cannot play any card with the same title as a card in your Ring area.

name: It's Your Own Fault
Text: Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the number of Reversal cards in your opponent's Ring area.

name: Lasso from El Paso
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after the card titled Eddie's Roll Up. As a maneuver, draw up to 2 cards or search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Leapfrog Stun Gun
Text: Can only be reversed by unique cards. Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver.

name: Los Guerreros
Text: Before damage has been applied from a card successfully played by your opponent, you can remove any number of Face or Heel cards in your Ringside pile from the game and reduce the damage by 2 for each card removed. You may play any cards with the Eddie Guerrero logo, but you do not count as Eddie Guerrero. You cannot play any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: Makin' a Difference
Text: Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Man of 1000 Holds
Text: Cannot be played by a Female Superstar. Your opponent cannot play Old School Wrestling Match. When you have 3+ 'Psychology' Ring cards, replace '3' and '4' with '1' in the text of your Ring Psychology: Back and Ring Psychology: Neck cards.

name: Mangled Intro by Lillian Garcia
Text: You cannot play Pre-match cards. The maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 2.

name: Mental Acumen
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. You may put 1 Face or Heel card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Face or Heel card and search your Arsenal for 1 Face or Heel card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Nidia Interferes
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, before your Draw Segment, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal. When overturned, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: No Gimmicks Needed
Text: You may search your Arsenal for the card titled Head, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your Ringside pile, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards to blank your opponent's Superstar Ability for the rest of the turn and during his next turn.

name: No One Wants to Watch Women Wrestle
Text: If your opponent is a Male Superstar, discard this card and draw 1 card. If your opponent is a Female Superstar, search his Arsenal for up to 5 Maneuver cards, put them into his Ringside pile, and your opponent shuffles his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area or Ringside pile, you may remove it from the game and your Reversal cards are unaffected by Fortitude modification for the rest of the turn.

name: Noggin Knocker
Text: Can only be played if your opponent cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts, if your opponent has a Pre-match Manager in his Ring area, or if this is a Tag Team format match. As a reversal, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any Action card if it is not the first action played this turn and end your opponent's turn.

name: Outside Interference
Text: Can only be played if you have a Pre-match Manager or the cards titled Manager Interferes or Backstage Politics in your Ring area. Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Pass the Buck
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent successfully plays a card that moves any number of cards into his Arsenal, put this card into his Ring area and he cannot draw any cards or move any cards into his Arsenal for the rest of the turn.

name: Perplex Opponent
Text: Your opponent reveals the top 6 cards of his Arsenal, puts 1 of those cards into his hand, and puts the rest into his Ringside pile.

name: Poke
Text: Can only be reversed by the card titled Step Aside.

name: Power Struggle
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for 1 Set-up card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, can only be played if the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Premiere Raw Superstar
Text: Can only be played when your Superstar Value is 3+. When this card is in your Ring and your Raw card is successful, your opponent discards 1 card; when they have 4- Hand cards, they may overturn 1 card instead (cannot be reversed). ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 Raw cards and then Ringside Search 1 non-unique Raw card.

name: Premiere Smackdown Superstar
Text: Can only be played if your Superstar Value is 3 or greater. When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a card with the Smackdown logo, you may draw 1 card. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card with the Smackdown logo and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Proper Planning Prevents Piss-poor Performance
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards and then shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, you may shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Pump Up the Crowd
Text: Can only be played if you are an inactive member of your team and if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. The active member of your team puts 1 card from his Ringside pile into his hand or shuffles up to 3 cards from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and if your next card played this turn is an Action card, it cannot be reversed.

name: Rabid Attack in the Corner
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 6D or greater maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and it cannot be reversed.

name: Raw Roulette Wheel
Text: Cannot be played by Right to Censor. Put 1 Stipulation card on top of this card and any number of Stipulation cards under this card. Any player on his turn may discard 1 card, put 1 Stipulation card on top of this card under it, and then put 1 random Stipulation card from under it on top of it. This card and the Stipulation card on top of this card are both considered in your Ring area.

name: Real Predictable...
Text: Cannot be played by a Female Superstar. Can only be played if your opponent has at least 7 maneuvers of the same type between his Ring area and Ringside pile. Search your opponent's Ringside pile and Arsenal for up to 5 Maneuver cards of that same type and remove them from the game. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, you may remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: Really, That's Enough
Text: This card is -6F when the card titled You're as Graceful as a Cow on Ice is in your Ring area. When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any card if it is not the first or second card played this turn and end his turn.

name: Rhyno
Text: Your Foreign Object cards do not have the Raw logo. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal cards from the top of your Arsenal until you reveal a Foreign Object. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your Ringside pile.

name: Rhyno's Garbage Can
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when you reveal cards for your Superstar Ability, you may put this card into your Ringside pile after you have revealed a Foreign Object card to shuffle all other revealed cards into your Arsenal.

name: Ring Psychology: Arm
Text: If you have 4 or more Grapple or Submission maneuvers in your Ring area with the words 'arm,''shoulder,'or 'wrist'in the title, your Grapple and Submission maneuvers are +4D and your opponent's non-High-Risk maneuvers do a maximum of 4D.

name: Ring Psychology: Leg
Text: If you have 3 or more Grapple or Submission maneuvers in your Ring area with the words 'knee,''leg,'or 'toe'in the title, your opponent cannot reverse any maneuver with the words 'knee,''leg,'or 'toe'in the title from his hand or Backlash deck. If you have 6 or more Grapple or Submission maneuvers in your Ring area with the words 'knee,''leg,'or 'toe'in the title, your opponent also cannot reverse any maneuver with the words 'knee,''leg,'or 'toe'in the title from his Arsenal.

name: Rolling Suplex
Text: When successfully played, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'suplex'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Screw the Rules!
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. Choose 1 Stipulation card in your or your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, the text on that card is blank.

name: Series of Punches
Text: Can only be played after the cards titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed by Unique cards or by cards that specifically reverse a maneuver played after the cards titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope.

name: Series of Stipulations
Text: You cannot play non-Stipulation Pre-match cards. The maximum number of Stipulation cards you may play is increased by 1.

name: Shake
Text: Can only be reversed by the card titled Escape Move.

name: Shawn Michaels
Text: You may pack an additional 2 Pre-match cards and an additional 2 Mid-match cards in your Backlash deck, and an up to additional 15 cards in your Arsenal.

name: Shining Wizard Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed. When successfully played, you may put 1 Backlash deck card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck.

name: Show Me Something!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, if your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in his hand, he overturns 1 card.

name: SmackDown! #1 Announcer Funaki
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 3 cards and then put 3 cards in your hand on top of your Arsenal.

name: Snap Slam
Text: When successfully played, your opponent may remove 1 card in your Ringside pile from the game.

name: Split Finger Lock
Text: As a maneuver, discard up to 5 cards and your opponent overturns the same number of cards. As an action, discard this card. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +3D.

name: Stacy Keibler, Marketing Manager
Text: You may put up to 2 cards titled Managed by Stacy Keibler from your Ringside pile into your Ring area and remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. When this card is in your Ring area, your cards titled Keibler's Cookies cannot be reversed, they are Permanent, and they are not Active.

name: Stephanie McMahon Decrees...
Text: Cannot be reversed if the card titled Managed by Stephanie McMahon-Helmsley is in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, ignore the words 'if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating'on your card titled Managed by Stephanie McMahon-Helmsley. Your Mid-match cards with the Smackdown logo have the added text of 'The maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1.'

name: Stomp a Mudhole...
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for the card titled ...Walk It Dry, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Stun the Crowd
Text: When this card is in your Ring, your cards with Stun are +1D and +1 Stun.

name: Submit!
Logos: Team Angle, Kurt Angle, Chris Benoit
Text: Put 1 Submission Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand and search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Surprise Drop Kick
Text: As a maneuver, you may put up to 2 non-Mid-match cards in your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Sweet Chin Music
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. As an action, this card is -30F and -20D, discard this card and put 1 other Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Take Care of Number One
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a card to your Ring area that shuffles any number of cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, shuffle in 1 additional card. If your Superstar is Team Angle, when you successfully play a Grapple or Submission maneuver, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Team Angle
Text: When you successfully play a Grapple or Submission maneuver, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. When your opponent reverses a Grapple or Submission maneuver, he discards 1 card. You may play the cards titled Intelligence, Integrity, Intensity, and Do YOU Live By the Three I's? You cannot play any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: Test
Text: Before your Draw Segment, your opponent discards # cards (# = number of their Hand cards greater than the total of 2 + your Hand cards). You can pack 6- additional Mid-match cards, and 2- copies of any Unique card, but you cannot pack more than 2 copies of any non-Unique card. You cannot pack Pre-match cards except Managed by Stacy Keibler (it is not Heel), and before the Pre-match phase, put 2- copies of that card into your Ring. You cannot pack non-Test-specific Faction or 'Anniversary' Backstage cards.

name: Test Drive
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 2D or greater maneuver. Draw up to 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You must discard 2 cards.

name: Test's Pump Handle Slam
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn

name: Test's Running Boot
Text: Can only be played if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn.

name: The Big, Bad Booty Daddy is Your Hook Up
Text: Shuffle up to 20 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. Your opponent may draw 1 card for every 4 cards shuffled in.

name: The Bionic Redneck
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: The Crippler
Text: When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card of the same type, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Maneuver card and put up to 3 Maneuver cards of the same type from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. You may pack any cards with the Chris Benoit logo, but you do not count as Chris Benoit.

name: The Devil's in the Detail
Text: You may put 1 card of 1D from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal and 1 card of 1D from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: The End Is Near
Text: You may put 1 Maneuver card, 1 Reversal card, and 1 Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand. If your next card played this turn is the card titled From the Top Rope, you can ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text. Smackdown logo

name: The Haas of Pain
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Heart Break Kid
Text: Your opponent overturns cards equal to his Superstar Value plus the number of Action and Maneuver cards in his Ring area.

name: The Icon ... The Showstoppa ... The Main Event
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, 1 non-Unique Reversal card, and 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your Superstar Value is +1.

name: The Manbeast
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may discard 5 cards to reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Reduce the number of cards discarded by 1 for every 2 Stun Value in your Ring area. The number of cards discarded cannot go below 2.

name: The Rattlesnake
Text: Non-unique cards and non-unique card effects cannot move cards from any Ringside pile to any other location. You can pack any cards with the Stone Cold Steve Austin logo, but you do not count as Stone Cold Steve Austin.

name: The Ref Takes Control
Text: Reverse any Foreign Object card or any maneuver played after the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and end your opponent's turn. If the card reversed is a Foreign Object card, remove it from the game.

name: There's No Holding Me Back
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage has been applied, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, search your Arsenal for the card titled Series of Suplexes, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and end your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your next turn is the card titled Series of Suplexes, it cannot be reversed.

name: This is Gonna Get Ugly
Text: You must discard 3 cards. Search your Arsenal for 2 different non-unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your opponent draws up to 3 cards.

name: Toothless Aggression
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank the maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn and end your opponent's turn.

name: Top Rope Elbow Drop
Text: Can only be played after the card titled From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Tossed Between the Ropes
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck. When successfully played, put up to 1 card in your opponent's Ring area that has an Activated Card Effect into his Ringside pile. Your next card played this turn is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. When successfully played by Rey Mysterio, you may also search your Arsenal for the card titled The 619, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Tu Locas, Ese ... You Crazy, Man
Text: Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. Discard 3 cards.

name: Version 1.0
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a Grapple maneuver, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: We Lie, We Cheat, We Steal
Text: Search your Arsenal for 3 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from under this card into your hand.

name: West Coast Bronco Buster
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: What's Mine is Mine and What's Yours is Mine
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when your hand is revealed, you may put up to 3 cards in your hand under this card. You may not have more than 6 cards under this card. You may play these cards as if they were in your hand. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any card that allows your opponent to search any Arsenal and end his turn. When this card is put into your Ringside pile from your Ring area, put all cards under this card into your hand.

name: X-treme Hedonism
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and put this card into your hand. When this card is in your Ring area, whenever you successfully play a Maneuver card you may draw 1 card or shuffle 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: X-treme Sendoff
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +2. When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1 and when you successfully play a card with the word 'xtreme'or 'x-treme'in the title, draw 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Yo Dawg, Respect da Bookerman
Text: If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, he discards 5 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, put 2 cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: You Can't Manhandle the Big Show
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put 2 cards from your hand on top of your Arsenal, then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent is Undertaker/Deadman Inc, Ric Flair, The Big Freak'n Machine, Brock Lesnar, or The Rattlesnake, the maximum number of Pre-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is decreased by 2.

name: You Make Me Sick!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, non-unique Reversal cards played from your hand are -#F, where # is equal to your opponent's Superstar Value.

name: You're a Human Vacuum Cleaner ... You Suck and Blow at the Same Time
Text: If your opponent's printed Superstar Value is 2 or less, his Superstar Value is +1 and he cannot play Title Belt cards. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent is Chris Jericho, Christian, The Crippler, Los Guerreros, or Team Angle, the maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 3.

name: You're Going to Space Mountain
Text: Remove the top 4 cards of your opponent's Arsenal from the game.
